title: 소개 시켜 줘
scene: 하늘이 학습자에게 「친구 소개해 줘」라고 한다. 학습자는 속이 탄다

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 너 친구 중에 괜찮은 사람 없어? 소개 좀 해 줘.
turns.rd: neo chingu junge gwaenchaneun saram eopseo? sogae jom hae jwo.
turns.en: Any decent people among your friends? Introduce me.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: What kind of person do you like?

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 음… 한국어 공부 열심히 하고, 편의점 라면 잘 끓이고.
turns.rd: eum… hangugeo gongbu yeolsimhi hago, pyeonuijeom ramyeon jal kkeuligo.
turns.en: Hmm… studies Korean hard, makes great convenience-store ramyeon.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: There are lots of people like that.

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 내 말에 매일 답장 빨리 하고, 우산 맨날 까먹고.
turns.rd: nae mare maeil dapjang ppalli hago, usan maennal kkameokgo.
turns.en: Replies to me fast every day, always forgets his umbrella.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: And is wearing a gray hoodie today.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: (quietly) I was wondering when you'd notice. You're really slow.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: …Guess I don't need to introduce anyone.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Then I'll make the ramyeon today.
